name: Sahaj Saliya
title: I build AI that reads, sees and acts.
tagline: AI engineer and B.Tech ICT student at PDEU, working on LLMs, NLP, computer vision, generative AI and agents.
about: I'm Sahaj, an AI engineer studying Information & Communication Technology at PDEU. I build systems that *read* text, *see* images and *act* through agents, and I measure them honestly.

Recent work: an ensemble that finds Crohn's lesions in capsule-endoscopy video, a multi-agent Corrective RAG orchestrator, and a reinforcement-learning environment where PPO and Llama agents learn to clean data, a language model that consolidates a day's notes into its weights overnight, entries in two Kaggle competitions (quantum circuit compilation and Santa 2026), and three shipped products (Smaran, vMix Manager and SentinelProxy). In 2026 I built LLM infrastructure (gateway, RAG runtime, memory layer) for 6G research at HNNOIX.

points: Worked on 6G research and development: network architectures, AI agents and communication systems.
Built reusable AI components (an LLM Gateway, a RAG Runtime, an AI Memory Layer and a Knowledge Base) for scalable agent execution, context management and workflow orchestration.
Applied generative AI, LLM, RAG and agent-based methods to decision-making, context-aware retrieval and workflow automation for 6G network architectures.
Built 2 autonomous trading-signal systems with agentic AI and RAG that read market news, extract sentiment and emit structured signals in real time.
Cut false-positive trade signals by 37% with filtering rules and confidence scoring.
Built a CrewAI research pipeline on GPT-4, the Bloomberg API, Financial Modeling Prep and Alpha Vantage for automated earnings analysis.
